title: Asamiya Sahityar Chamu Buranji Ed. 3rd
author: Jatindranath Goswami
description: Comprehensive concise history of Assamese literature detailing early oral traditions, Charyapada affiliations, Tai Ahom royal patronage of chronicles, Charit-puthis, and the emergence of modern prose.

sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai historical chronicles introduced realistic secular prose into regional literature.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Jatindranath Goswami (Literary Historian)
sentences.notes: Evaluation of Buranji prose in Assamese literature.
